stories.title: Fictional example: a model provider adds batch processing
stories.score_reason: Illustrates how an operational change can matter equally to implementation and customer conversations.

plain.what_happened: In this fictional example, a provider lets customers submit many AI requests together and receive results later.
plain.why_it_matters: Work that does not need an instant answer could be handled differently from a live customer chat. Actual pricing would need verification.
plain.customer_angle: Ask which workloads truly need a real-time response. Overnight document processing may have different requirements.

technical.what_changed: This fictional release introduces asynchronous batch jobs: submit work, then retrieve results after processing.
technical.implementation: A production integration would need job tracking, per-item error handling, retry rules, and a completion check.
technical.availability_and_limits: No real API, price, throughput limit, or service-level commitment is represented by this example.
technical.try_or_ask: Identify one non-interactive workload and define its acceptable completion time before selecting a provider.
